title: Expressionless Face Emoji 😑 Meaning: Annoyed and Done
description: The expressionless face emoji 😑 is three flat lines of pure exasperation: “I'm done,” “seriously?” or “no comment.” See what it means and how it differs from 😐.
summary: 😑 has straight lines for both eyes and its mouth, as if it has closed its eyes to gather patience. It means the sender is exasperated, fed up or unimpressed to the point of having nothing left to say. It is a stronger, wearier version of 😐.
meaning: The closed eyes are the key. 😑 looks like someone who has shut their eyes, breathed in and counted to ten. People send it when a situation is so irritating or stupid that responding properly feels like wasted effort: the bus that drives past, the coworker who replies-all again, the friend who cancels for the third time. It is a sigh you can see.

Aimed at a person, it says “I can't believe you.” After a terrible pun, a forgotten errand or an obviously bad decision, 😑 is the reaction of someone who expected this and is tired anyway. Between friends, couples and siblings it is usually affectionate exasperation. The sender is annoyed in the way you can only be with people you are stuck with and fond of.

It also works as “no comment.” When a message does not deserve an answer, or any honest answer would start a fight, 😑 fills the space. That makes it useful and a little dangerous. The recipient knows you are displeased but not exactly why, and a conversation can cool quickly if that is the only thing you send.

Self-directed use is common too. “Locked my keys in the car 😑” turns the weariness on the sender's own mistakes. In this form it is close to a facepalm, minus the drama: no outcry, only flat acceptance that this is how the day is going and that complaining louder would not change it.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: It reacts to annoyances big and small, and to jokes that deserve a groan. As a single-emoji reply it ends the topic: the sender has nothing more to add. Stretched out as 😑😑😑, it shows the irritation is building. If a partner sends it after you explain why you are late, an apology is in order.

contexts.label: From a crush
contexts.body: In playful banter, 😑 is a mock-annoyed response to teasing, and it means they are enjoying the back-and-forth. In a serious exchange it shows real irritation or disappointment. The difference is usually obvious from what you said just before. When unsure, a light “too much?” clears it up.

contexts.label: At work
contexts.body: Coworkers trade it privately about shared frustrations: system outages, shifting deadlines, meetings that run over. In a public channel or directed at a specific person, it is an open display of contempt for what they said. Keep it to direct messages with people who share the complaint.

contexts.label: On social media
contexts.body: It captions everyday frustrations and reacts to posts that are painfully obvious, repetitive or tone-deaf. It is a favorite for “when you…” memes about minor suffering, such as stepping in a puddle in socks. Under news stories it expresses tired disapproval, the feeling of having seen this before.

examples.text: The wifi went out right before I hit save 😑
examples.meaning: Worn-down frustration at an annoying bit of bad luck.

examples.text: You're telling me now that you're allergic? After I cooked? 😑
examples.meaning: Exasperated with someone for sharing important information too late.

examples.text: “Why did the scarecrow win an award?” 😑
examples.meaning: Refusing to be amused by a predictable dad joke.

examples.text: Left my lunch on the kitchen counter 😑
examples.meaning: Annoyed at oneself for a small, avoidable mistake.
As a lone reply: “I have no response to that,” usually with irritation.
Patience running out with someone who keeps changing plans.

combos.meaning: Exaggerated, dark-humor frustration or boredom; “I can't take this anymore.”
Speechless at someone's foolishness, including one's own.
So bored or unimpressed that the sender is practically falling asleep.

confusedWith.difference: 😐 keeps its eyes open in a blank stare and is milder: unimpressed, deadpan. 😑 shuts its eyes too, which adds fatigue and finality. If 😐 is the stare, 😑 is the long exhale after it.
😒 glances sideways with a slight frown, showing resentment, jealousy or sulking, often about a specific person. 😑 is flatter and more tired. 😒 holds a grudge; 😑 has given up reacting.
😴 also has closed eyes but adds “zzz” and an open mouth, meaning actual sleep or total boredom. 😑 is awake and annoyed. At small sizes they can look alike, so the zzz is what to check for.

avoid: Do not send it as your only response to someone's sincere explanation or apology, because it shuts the conversation down.
Avoid it in group or work channels when reacting to a named person's message.
Skip it when you are only tired, since readers will take it as annoyance; 😴 or 🥱 says sleepy more clearly.
design: A yellow face made of three short horizontal lines: two for closed eyes and one for the mouth. No brows, cheeks or other details appear on most platforms. It matches 😐 except that the eyes are lines instead of dots, and vendors render it almost identically. The line thickness and spacing are the only things that change.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 😑 and 😐?
faqs.a: The eyes. 😐 is open-eyed and merely unimpressed. 😑 has closed its eyes, which reads as exasperation, like someone pausing to keep their temper. Use 😐 for “hm, okay” and 😑 for “I am so done with this.”

It means irritated more than angry. The feeling is tired annoyance, not rage. Someone sending 😑 has usually decided the matter is not worth a fight, though repeated use in one conversation is a sign their patience is thin.
It can be dismissive. Sent in reply to a person's opinion or effort, it tells them you think it is not worth a response. Used about traffic, weather, chores or your own mistakes, it is just venting.

faqs.q: What does 😑 mean from a girl or a guy?
faqs.a: The meaning is the same from anyone: they are fed up or playfully pretending to be. If you were teasing them, it is part of the game. If you cancelled, forgot something or were late, they are annoyed and saying so mildly.
Some people use it that way because the eyes are closed, but most readers will see irritation. If you mean you are exhausted, pairing it with words or choosing 😴, 😪 or 🥱 avoids a misunderstanding.
